title: Enantioselective [2,3]-Wittig rearrangement of allyl picolyl ethers with chiral lithium amides
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36175-36178
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06385J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Midori Kawasaki, Kenji Yatsuzuka, Ryuichi Shirai
Highly enantioselective [2,3]-Wittig rearrangement of 2-(allyloxymethyl)pyridine using chiral lithium amides to give 1-(2-pyridyl)-3-butenol with up to 95% ee was achieved.
